page_title: STR 3-1 NAN | Strasbourg v Nantes 27/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.
90+6' Nathan Zeze (Nantes) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
90+6' Is that a yellow card in the referee's hand? It is! Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) gets booked.
90+4' Liam Rosenior has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Eduard Sobol (Strasbourg) replacing Dilane Bakwa.
90+4' It is time for a substitution. Daouda Diongue (Strasbourg) is on for Diego Moreira.
90+4' Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) misses an absolute sitter after connecting with a cross inside the penalty box.
90+2' It must be a yellow card. It is. Ignatius Ganago (Nantes) receives the caution after an awful tackle.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem blows his whistle as Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
87' Yellow card. Johann Lepenant (Nantes) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
84' A substitution has been made. Douglas Augusto is replaced by Johann Lepenant (Nantes).
84' The manager makes a subsitution with Florent Mollet (Nantes) coming on for Sorba Thomas.
84' Liam Rosenior prepares a substitution. Sebastian Nanasi is replaced by Felix Lemarechal (Strasbourg).
84' Substitution. Junior Mwanga (Strasbourg) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Andrey Santos walks off.
83' 3 - 1 Goal! Douglas Augusto passes the ball to Bahereba Guirassy (Nantes) and he fires in a shot from the edge of the box which is deflected. Djordje Petrovic couldn't do anything about it. 3:1.
82' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Alban Lafont, who smothers the ball.
79' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 8:6.
76' Substitution. Sekou Mara makes his way off the pitch and Abakar Sylla (Strasbourg) comes on as his replacement.
74' The Strasbourg players joy may have been justified, because referee Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem is going use VAR to determine whether it was offside.
73' 3 - 0 GOAL! Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) finishes off a sublime move with a delightful back-heel goal. Diego Moreira provided the assist with a brilliant pass. 3:0.
73' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) has a goal ruled out for offside!
71' Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg) takes the corner but it's cleared.
68' Substitution. Bahereba Guirassy (Nantes) has come on for Matthis Abline.
68' Antoine Kombouare has decided to make a change. Pedro Chirivella (Nantes) replaces Jean-Philippe Gbamin.
68' We are about to witness a substitution. Ignatius Ganago (Nantes) is replacing Tino Kadewere.
67' The game is interrupted. One of the players from Nantes is cautioned for aggressive play.
65' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) tries to find Sebastian Nanasi, but he puts too much power on the through ball.

65' Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the left side of the goal. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Djordje Petrovic makes a comfortable save.
63' Guela Doue (Strasbourg) is able to continue to play.
61' Guela Doue (Strasbourg) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
57' 2 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Dilane Bakwa sprays a pass out to Andrey Santos (Strasbourg), and he has an easy job to slot the ball into an empty net. The score is 2:0.
57' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
56' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) inside the box. The ball goes out of play. Strasbourg are awarded a corner kick.
54' Sorba Thomas (Nantes) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
51' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
49' Sorba Thomas (Nantes) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.

49' Douglas Augusto (Nantes) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper, but his effort is straight at Djordje Petrovic, who is alert and makes an easy save to deny him. The linesman makes the right call and Nantes will have a corner.
47' Half-chance! Sorba Thomas (Nantes) plays a pass into the box, but Djordje Petrovic reacts well to snuff out the attack.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+2' Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
44' Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem blows his whistle for a foul.
43' Nantes enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
42' Sorba Thomas (Nantes) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball goes out of play and Strasbourg will have a goal kick.
38' Andrey Santos (Strasbourg) has tested the patience of referee Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
36' Marcus Coco (Nantes) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
35' Marcus Coco (Nantes) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
35' A player from Strasbourg commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
35' Nantes failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
34' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Strasbourg force a corner. They send men into the box.
34' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.

32' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the top right corner. Alban Lafont guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save. The ball goes out of play and Strasbourg have been awarded a corner kick.
31' Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
31' Tino Kadewere (Nantes) latches on to a cross on the edge of the box and fires a shot at goal, but his effort was blocked by one of the defenders.
30' Flag up against Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
28' Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
26' OFF THE WOODWORK! Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg) picks up the ball inside the box and produces a snap shot that smashes against the crossbar!
25' Neat passing move from Nantes in order to create new attacking opportunities.
22' The resulting corner from Sorba Thomas (Nantes) is cleared.

17' 1 - 0 It's a goal! Andrey Santos (Strasbourg) makes it 1:0. He jumped highest to connect with a perfect cross from Habib Diarra and planted his close-range header into the middle of the goal. Alban Lafont was helpless.
16' Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
14' The resulting corner from Sorba Thomas (Nantes) is cleared by the defence.
13' Matthis Abline (Nantes) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball is out of play and Nantes manage to earn a corner.
12' Nicolas Cozza (Nantes) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again.
11' Tino Kadewere (Nantes) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
10' The shot by Sorba Thomas (Nantes) from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and is easily saved by Djordje Petrovic.
8' Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
8' Matthis Abline (Nantes) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
7' Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) latches onto a good pass inside the box and shoots. The effort beats the keeper, but deflects off the left post to safety.
5' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Strasbourg.
